the_ruling_verbatim: chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention.
what about cairn/skills ??? it's full of them?
sigh. tools don't have owners they have users.
now_the_spec_says: chart is a SKILL that CALLS machines — it does not hold them. A machine berths by RUNG at cairn/machines/<name>/ whoever calls it; the skill berths at skills/chart/ with only its own edge. chart's charter, state and history dissolve into the skill.
supersedes_and_why: 2026-08-13-chart-is-a-skill-that-calls-machines read the ruling as 'a skill holds its parts under skills/<skill>/ the way a device does, so the chart legs berth at skills/chart/machines/<name>/'. That reading was WRONG in the direction the ruling was correcting, and Akien's own next words are the correction: 'what about cairn/skills ??? it's full of them?' — I had invented a blocker (a skill has no holder in class-space) and then invented a nesting to solve it, when skills/ already existed and the rung roots already say where a machine lives. CALLS is not HOLDS. A machine under skills/chart/machines/ would be reachable only by chart, which is the coupling the decomposition removed, not a shape for it. The retired packet also named cairn/cairn/machines/chart/intention+why.json as a file that would CONFORM, when the ruling's actual consequence is that the file DIES — its body belongs to the skill. That is a what_dies entry, not a what_conforms one, and the gate caught it exactly there ('VANISHED: was to conform, not to die'). WHY what_dies IS EMPTY HERE AND THAT IS ITSELF A FINDING: the file is ALREADY dead, so the intake gate refuses to accept it as a death it can witness ('does not exist at intake — already dead, or invented'). It is right to. This packet is a CORRECTION filed after the move, and the ruling gate's whole point is that packets are filed BEFORE code moves — a death it did not see is a death it cannot prove. The death is recorded in prose here and witnessed by git (commit bf80d5d) rather than by the gate, and that is a weaker record, on purpose, rather than a field bent to look strong.
